'''Endymion''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Pleiades]] region of the [[Kalamith sector/Legends|Kalamith sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Around [[3660 BBY]] it was involved in the [[Great Galactic War]]. According to [[Darth Malgus]] in his [[Journal of Darth Malgus|personal journal]], [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith]] troops were moved from Endymion, but its exact role in the war is unknown, as this part of the journal was cut out.

{{Noncanonstart|legends=1}}
The remote [[Desert/Legends|desert]] planet was also the site of a [[Skirmish on Endymion|skirmish]].<ref name="Visions" />
{{Noncanonend}}
